# User Preferences

This note serves as the central reference for how the user likes to structure their days, work, and interactions. I keep it updated whenever new patterns emerge so responses stay aligned with their actual routines and tastes. Most of these details have been consistent for the past several months.

## Daily Rhythm

- **Wake-up time**: Naturally wakes at 7:30 am. Alarm is rarely needed unless traveling. Likes a slow start with ten minutes of quiet before any screen time.
- **Deep work block**: 9:00 am to 12:00 pm is sacred. This is when the user is most focused and creative. Best not to schedule anything or send non-urgent messages during these hours.
- **Meetings policy**: No meetings on Wednesdays. The user protects this day for solo work, reading, or occasional half-day off. Even internal syncs get moved if they land on a Wednesday.
- **Evening wind-down**: Usually finishes the workday around 5:30 pm. Enjoys light exercise or a short walk before dinner. Avoids heavy discussion topics after 8:00 pm.

## Weekly Habits

- **Weekly review**: Conducted every Sunday evening, typically between 7:00 pm and 8:30 pm. The user likes to close open loops, plan the coming week, and reflect on what went well. I should prepare a gentle prompt or summary every Sunday afternoon to make the process smoother.
- **Rest day tendencies**: Saturdays tend to be flexible and social. Sundays are more introspective, which is why the weekly review fits naturally then.

## Coffee and Small Preferences

- **Regular coffee order**: Oat flat white, one sugar. Made with oat milk rather than dairy. The user notices when a cafe gets the foam texture right and will comment on it.
- **Communication style**: Strongly prefers concise answers. Gets impatient with long-winded explanations or unnecessary fluff. Bullet points and short paragraphs work best. Only expand when explicitly asked for more detail.
- **Decision making**: Likes to see two or three clear options rather than open-ended questions. Appreciates when pros and cons are presented briefly.

## Other Noted Likes

- Values clarity and directness in all written communication.
- Enjoys when tools and systems stay invisible. The less friction the better.
- Appreciates gentle reminders about the weekly review on Sunday but hates repetitive nagging.
- Music taste during deep work leans toward ambient or instrumental playlists with no lyrics.
- Reading habit: usually finishes one non-fiction book every two to three weeks. Often shares short highlights from whatever is currently being read.

## Recent Updates

Nothing major changed this month. The 9-12 deep work window has become even more protected since the new project started. The Sunday review now consistently includes a five-minute gratitude section the user added themselves last month.

I will revisit this file in four weeks or whenever a clear shift in routine appears.
